nodes.label: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)

nodes.norm_label: sequence position numbering strategy (max over all rows)

nodes.label: Soft Delete with Discovery Ignore Marker
nodes.community_name: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)
nodes.norm_label: soft delete with discovery ignore marker

nodes.label: E09-T01: Number discovered VMs from MAX(sequence_position)
nodes.community_name: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)

nodes.label: E09-T02: AWS discovery calls report failure and skip missing-VM flagging
nodes.community_name: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)
nodes.norm_label: e09-t02: aws discovery calls report failure and skip missing-vm flagging

nodes.label: E09-T03: Harden discovery strategies
nodes.community_name: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)

nodes.label: E09-T04: Scope tag reconciliation to untagged VMs
nodes.community_name: Narrow Conditional DB Updates (avoid whole-row saves)
nodes.norm_label: e09-t04: scope tag reconciliation to untagged vms

nodes.label: E09-T05: Load VMs with group/environment for state sync and apply with conditional updates

nodes.norm_label: e09-t05: load vms with group/environment for state sync and apply with conditional updates

nodes.label: E09-T06: Require N consecutive NOT_FOUND results before deactivating; add VM reactivate path

nodes.norm_label: e09-t07: fix eks sync status mapping, add transitional guard, keep aws calls out of db transactions
